pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Space Mountain Ear Headband Pin
pins.series: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction
pins.notes: The ear headband pin from the January 2020 Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction pin set. Each monthly drop was sold as a 3-pin Limited Release set for $19.99 (the $19.99 figure is the set price, not the price of this pin alone) and each month also had a matching wearable ear headband, mug, plush, bag and journal. Released at Walt Disney World and Disneyland; from March 2020 onward sold on shopDisney through the MerchPass lottery. PinPics PP138035 ("Earband - Minnie Main Attraction - Space Mountain - January 2020"). White bow with galaxy-print ears and a clear jewel in the centre of the bow. Collector databases catalog the headband pin separately ("Ear Headband Pin" / "Ears Headband ONLY") from the full set.

pins.name: WDW Hidden Disney 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands — Ariel
pins.series: Hidden Disney 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands (Walt Disney World)
pins.notes: One of 7 pins in the Walt Disney World Ear Headbands set of the Hidden Disney 2025 Wave A cast-lanyard series, released 1 January 2025. Shaped like a classic Disney ear headband and carrying the small hidden-Mickey icon. Not initially purchasable — obtainable only by trading with cast members; from April 2025 silver pouches holding two random 2025 Hidden Disney pins were sold for $19.99, so no single-pin retail price exists. Chasers and super chasers were only found in the pouches. PinPics files this set as "Earbands - Hidden Disney 2025 - Wave A - Set 2"; Pin & Pop pin ID 90918.

pins.name: Hidden Disney 2026 Wave A: Ear Headbands — Maleficent
pins.series: Hidden Disney 2026 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: Part of the Hidden Disney 2026 Wave A Ear Headbands set (7 pins), first available 12 January 2026 via cast-member trading, with mystery pouches following in spring 2026 — chasers and super chasers are pouch-only. CONTRADICTION IN SOURCES on which resort: DisneyPinsBlog's 2026 Wave A round-up puts an Ear Headbands set featuring Maleficent, Figment, Zazu, Star Tours and Jasmine with a Jaq & Gus chaser and a Hatbox Ghost super chaser in the Disneyland collection, while Pin & Pop's DLR 2026 Wave A Ear Headbands series lists Snow White, Evil Queen, a Sleeping Beauty chaser and a Madame Leota super chaser instead. The likeliest reading is that WDW and DLR each got their own 2026 Ear Headbands set and the blog conflated them (Figment is an EPCOT character), but I could not verify this — treat the resort attribution on this record as unconfirmed. Disney Pinventory catalogs the Hatbox Ghost super chaser as item 49522. No single-pin retail price: Hidden Disney pins are not sold individually.

DisneyPinsBlog lists the 12 designs as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy, Pluto, Chip and Dale (one shared pin), Stitch, Angel, Judy, Nick and a secret. Release year, retail price and the identity of the secret design are unknown. Also sold in the West by import resellers as "TDR Headbands Shaped Pin Badge Set of 2 Mystery".

pins.name: Disney Villains Ear Headband Pin Set — Maleficent
pins.series: Disney Character Ear Headbands — Villains
pins.notes: One of four pins in the Disney Villains Ear Headband Pin Set — ear-headband-shaped pins themed to Maleficent, the Evil Queen, Hades and Jafar. Limited Release, $29.99 for the 4-pin set (not per pin), available from 11 April 2023 at Disneyland. Part of Pin & Pop's broader "Disney Character Ear Headbands" umbrella series (Villains subset, pin #62053). The horned black Maleficent headband — the best-documented Maleficent ear headband pin.

pins.name: Pixar Character Ear Headbands — Remy
pins.series: Pixar Character Ear Headbands
pins.notes: Pin & Pop catalogs a "Pixar Character Ear Headbands" series of 10 ear-headband-shaped pins including Remy, Sulley, Bo Peep, Coco, Anger and Miguel; the remaining four designs, the release year, retailer and edition type were not confirmed. A companion "Pixar Mickey Mouse Ears Headband Pin Set" pin book also exists on Pin & Pop. Origin recorded as Disney Store as a best guess and should be treated as unverified.
